verdict.rationale: mise's own `mise watch` re-runs tasks automatically when files change, and community users describe `[hooks]` postinstall entries that run commands automatically after `mise install`. Together these give event-triggered automation of mise tasks, though nothing shows them running detached in the background or unattended. Missing for 10: scheduled or cron-style triggers, background/daemon execution of automations, agent-initiated autonomous runs beyond MCP task invocation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
